app.name: Notes Maker
app.tagline: Your notes, kept on your device.

note.convertWarnBody: Formatting like bold text and headings will be flattened into plain list items.
note.count: {count, plural, =0 {No notes} one {# note} other {# notes}}

empty.title: Nothing here yet.
empty.body: Your first note is one keystroke away.

storage.title: Storage
storage.persistenceExplain: Browsers sometimes clear stored data to free up space. Protecting this site prevents that.
storage.quotaWarning: You're running low on space. Export a backup, and remove some images to free room.
storage.resetExplain: Deletes every note on this device. This cannot be undone.
storage.siteTotalHint: Includes the app files your browser caches so it works offline — not your notes.

backup.title: Backup
backup.explain: Your notes live only in this browser. A backup file is the way to move them or get them back.

error.not_a_zip: That file isn't a readable backup.
error.missing_manifest: That backup is missing its manifest.
error.missing_notes: That backup contains no notes file.
error.unsupported_version: That backup was made by a newer version. Update the app first.
error.missing_image: That backup references an image it doesn't contain.
error.malformed: That backup is damaged and can't be read safely.
error.unknown: Something went wrong reading that file.

eviction.title: Your notes were removed by your browser
eviction.body: Browsers sometimes clear stored data to free up space. This wasn't something you did.

landing.heroBody: Free, no account, and stored in your own browser. Nothing is sent to any server.

features.privacyBody: Your notes live in your own browser's storage. They never touch a server unless you one day pay us to sync them.
features.checklistBody: Capture starts as a checklist, and checklists are unlimited — on every plan.
features.offlineBody: Install it like an app and write anywhere. No connection needed, ever.

editor.none: Select a note, or write a new one.

imageError.unsupported_type: That file type is not supported.
imageError.decode_failed: That image could not be read.
imageError.encode_failed: That image could not be processed.
imageError.quota: Not enough space left for images. Export a backup and free some room.
imageError.unknown: That image could not be added.

fileError.too_large: That file is over the 25 MB limit.
fileError.quota: Not enough space left for attachments. Export a backup and free some room.
fileError.unsupported_type: That file type is not supported.
fileError.decode_failed: That image could not be read.
fileError.encode_failed: That image could not be processed.
fileError.unknown: That file could not be added.

archive.title: Archive
archive.emptyBody: Archived notes stay out of your way but stay searchable.

trash.title: Trash
trash.emptyBody: Notes here are deleted forever after 30 days.
trash.deleteForeverBody: This note will be deleted permanently. This cannot be undone.
trash.daysLeft: {count, plural, =0 {Deleted on next open} one {# day left} other {# days left}}
trash.confirmBody: {count, plural, one {# note} other {# notes}} will be deleted permanently. This cannot be undone.

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.bestEffortNote: Without an account, reminders fire only while the app is open. Reliable notifications on every device arrive with sync.
reminders.emptyBody: Open any note and tap the bell to get a daily or weekly nudge.

suggestions.title: Capture suggestions
suggestions.explain: Quick suggestions come from what you capture often. Everything is computed and stored on this device only.
